enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn over. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stretch arms. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash water on face. Pick up facial cleanser. Squeeze cleanser onto hand. Rub hands together. Apply to face. Massage face. Rinse face with water. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face dry. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed weekend breakfast with tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, butter. Close refrigerator. Take out bread from breadbox. Place bread on counter. Take out frying pan from cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Whisk eggs. Pour mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Butter toast. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Let tea steep. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Pick up toast. Bite toast. Drink tea. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Carry to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living space and vacuuming
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up items on floor. Place items in storage. Pick up cushions. Fluff cushions. Place cushions on couch. Pick up magazines. Stack magazines. Place on shelf. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug vacuum into outlet. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Pull vacuum back. Vacuum under couch. Vacuum corners. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away. Wipe coffee table with cloth. Arrange decorations. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local market
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up reusable bags. Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to local market. Enter market. Pick up shopping basket. Walk to produce section. Select apples. Place apples in basket. Select bananas. Place bananas in basket. Walk to dairy section. Pick up milk. Place milk in basket. Pick up eggs. Place eggs in basket. Walk to bakery. Pick up bread. Place bread in basket. Walk to checkout. Place items on counter. Pay cashier. Receive change. Place items in bags. Pick up bags. Walk out of market. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Place grocery bags on kitchen counter. Open bag. Take out milk. Place milk in refrigerator. Take out eggs. Place eggs in refrigerator. Take out apples. Place apples in fruit bowl. Take out bananas. Place bananas in fruit bowl. Take out bread. Place bread in breadbox. Fold reusable bags. Put bags in drawer. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a light lunch at home
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce, tomatoes, cheese. Close refrigerator. Wash lettuce. Tear lettuce into bowl. Chop tomatoes. Add tomatoes to bowl. Grate cheese. Add cheese to bowl. Open can of tuna. Add tuna to bowl. Mix salad. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat salad. Drink water. Finish meal. Carry plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Stop on movie. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust cushion. Lie down on couch. Watch TV. Sit up. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a walk and jogging in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Change into exercise clothes. Put on running shoes. Pick up keys. Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to park. Enter park. Start walking. Increase pace to jog. Jog along path. Pass other joggers. Turn around at end of path. Jog back. Slow to walk. Stop at bench. Sit on bench. Drink water from bottle. Stand up. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick out clothes. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk back to bathroom. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer to plan upcoming community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk in bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open calendar. Open document. Type notes. Open email. Read emails. Reply to email. Open program planning software. Create new event. Enter event details. Save event. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Save spreadsheet. Close programs. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken, vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Season chicken. Place chicken in baking dish. Place dish in oven. Turn on oven. Set timer. Wash rice. Place rice in pot. Add water. Turn on stove. Cook rice. Stir rice. Check chicken. Turn off stove. Take rice off stove. Take chicken out of oven. Place on plates. Carry plates to table.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut chicken. Eat chicken. Pick up spoon. Eat rice. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Continue eating. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Carry to sink. Pick up glass. Carry to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food from plates into trash. Rinse plates. Load plates into dishwasher. Load glasses into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash pots and pans. Rinse pots and pans. Place on drying rack. Drain sink. Wipe counters with cloth. Wipe stove. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Like post. Comment on post. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check email. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Enter bedroom. Close door. Turn off light. Undress. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Sleep.
